title: The Suicide Squad
about: A team of supervillains is dropped onto the island of Corto Maltese on a mission that goes very wrong.
cue: Serve the snacks when the squad cuts loose in a Corto Maltese bar.
faces: Serve the snacks when the squad cuts loose in a Corto Maltese bar.
"If I die because I gambled on love, it will be a worthy death."
Grilled lime and chilli chicken thighs, long grain rice and black beans
Harley's palace eye fillet and red wine
Date night. Killing kids? Kind of a red flag.
Baked beef empanadas with cumin and green olives
Bocconcini, cherry tomato and basil on toothpicks, balsamic dots
Buttery starfish cookies in pink and blue, for Starro the Conqueror
Mango, coconut milk and lime blended with ice, rum for adult glasses
Whatever's left on the line. Prices subject to change. Form CF-21. 2021.

Belle Reve Mess HallThe Suicide SquadMission one: snacks.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCorto Maltese empanadasBaked beef empanadas with cumin and green olivesHow to make it400g beef mince1 brown onion1 tsp ground cumin100g green olives3 sheets of shortcrust pastry1 bunch parsley2 garlic cloves2 tbsp red wine vinegar80ml olive oilDice the onion and chop the olives.Brown the mince with onion and cumin, stir in the olives and cool.Cut pastry into rounds, fill, fold and crimp.Bake at 200°C until golden.Blitz parsley, garlic, vinegar and oil for chimichurri.Polka-Dot Man's spotty skewersBocconcini, cherry tomato and basil on toothpicks, balsamic dotsHow to make it250g bocconcini250g cherry tomatoes1 bunch basil100ml balsamic vinegar2 tbsp olive oilReduce the balsamic in a small pan until syrupy and cool.Thread bocconcini, tomatoes and basil onto toothpicks.Lay on a white platter and drizzle with oil.Dot the balsamic all over the plate.MainsJungle mission chickenGrilled lime and chilli chicken thighs, long grain rice and black beansHow to make it1kg chicken thighs3 limes4 garlic cloves2 red chillies300g long grain rice1 can black beans2 tomatoes1 red onionsalt, to tasteMarinate the chicken in lime juice, crushed garlic, chopped chilli and salt.Leave to marinate.Cook the rice and warm the drained beans.Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through.Make a salsa of diced tomato, red onion and lime.Harley's palace eye fillet and red wineDate night. Killing kids? Kind of a red flag.How to make itAs written, serves 4Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare, sliced with a red wine sauce and crispy potatoes roasted in butter.Season a 1kg beef eye fillet, sear on all sides and roast at 200°C for 20 to 25 minutes for medium-rare.Rest 10 minutes.Toss 1kg halved chat potatoes in 40g melted butter, salt and rosemary and roast at 200°C for 40 minutes.Deglaze the beef pan with 200ml red wine and a crushed garlic clove, add 200ml beef stock and reduce by half, then whisk in 20g cold butter.Slice the beef thick and pour over the sauce.SweetsStarro starfish cookiesButtery starfish cookies in pink and blue, for Starro the ConquerorHow to make it250g butter100g caster sugar350g plain flour250g icing sugar1 tsp pink and blue food colouringBeat the butter and sugar, then mix in the flour.Roll out and cut into starfish shapes.Bake at 160°C.Cool completely.Ice pink and blue with icing sugar, colouring and a little water, and pipe white dots along each arm.DrinksCorto Maltese mango batidaMango, coconut milk and lime blended with ice, rum for adult glassesHow to make it2 mangoes200ml coconut milk2 limes2 tbsp caster sugar2 cups of ice120ml white rumPeel the mangoes and juice the limes.Blend the mango, coconut milk, lime juice, sugar and ice until smooth.Pour into four glasses and add a measure of rum to the adult glasses only.
